custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the printed patterns on the diaper. AI often struggles with rendering coherent text or distinct shapes on curved, folded surfaces. Check if the patterns melt into the fabric or have inconsistent perspective. Also, verify that the elastic gathers look physically tensioned rather than just painted on.
